names.name: Muhammad
names.note: The name of the Final Prophet (ﷺ). Most common Islamic name worldwide.

names.name: Ahmad
names.note: Another name of the Prophet (ﷺ) mentioned in the Quran (61:6).

names.name: Ali
names.note: Name of the fourth Caliph and cousin of the Prophet (ﷺ).

names.name: Umar
names.note: Name of the second Caliph, Umar ibn al-Khattab (رضي الله عنه).

names.name: Uthman
names.note: Name of the third Caliph, Uthman ibn Affan (رضي الله عنه).

names.name: Abu Bakr
names.meaning: Father of the young camel; father of Bakr
names.note: Kunya of the first Caliph, Abdallah ibn Abi Quhafa (رضي الله عنه).

names.name: Ibrahim
names.note: Prophet Abraham (عليه السلام), called Khalilullah (Friend of Allah).

names.name: Ismail
names.note: Son of Prophet Ibrahim (عليه السلام), ancestor of the Arabs.

names.name: Yusuf
names.note: Prophet Joseph (عليه السلام), his story is told in Surah Yusuf.

names.name: Hassan
names.note: Grandson of the Prophet (ﷺ), son of Ali and Fatima.

names.name: Hussain
names.note: Grandson of the Prophet (ﷺ), son of Ali and Fatima, martyred at Karbala.

names.name: Abdullah
names.note: The name of the Prophet's (ﷺ) father. Most virtuous compound name.

names.name: Abdul Rahman
names.note: One of the most beloved names to Allah according to hadith.

names.name: Khalid
names.note: Name of the famous Companion and general Khalid ibn al-Walid.

names.name: Bilal
names.note: Bilal ibn Rabah (رضي الله عنه), the first muezzin of Islam.

names.name: Salman
names.note: Salman al-Farisi (رضي الله عنه), the Persian Companion of the Prophet (ﷺ).

names.name: Tariq
names.note: Named after the star. Also the name of the Andalusian conqueror Tariq ibn Ziyad.

names.name: Zayd
names.note: Zayd ibn Haritha (رضي الله عنه), the adopted son of the Prophet (ﷺ).

names.name: Hamza
names.note: Uncle of the Prophet (ﷺ), known as the 'Lion of Allah', martyred at Uhud.

names.name: Musa
names.note: Prophet Moses (عليه السلام), most mentioned prophet in the Quran.

names.name: Isa
names.note: Prophet Jesus (عليه السلام), born of Maryam (Mary), called Ruhullah (Spirit of Allah).

names.name: Yahya
names.note: Prophet John the Baptist (عليه السلام), son of Zakariya.

names.name: Dawud
names.note: Prophet David (عليه السلام), king and prophet, to whom the Psalms (Zabur) were revealed.

names.name: Sulayman
names.note: Prophet Solomon (عليه السلام), son of Dawud, who was given power over jinn and animals.

names.name: Idris
names.note: Prophet Enoch (عليه السلام), mentioned in the Quran as a man of truth and a prophet.

names.name: Nuh
names.note: Prophet Noah (عليه السلام), builder of the Ark, one of the five Ulul Azm prophets.

names.name: Adam
names.note: The first human and first prophet (عليه السلام), created from clay by Allah.

names.name: Harun
names.note: Prophet Aaron (عليه السلام), brother and helper of Musa.

names.name: Ilyas
names.note: Prophet Elijah (عليه السلام), mentioned in the Quran as one of the righteous.

names.name: Zakariya
names.note: Prophet Zechariah (عليه السلام), father of Yahya.

names.name: Salih
names.note: Prophet Salih (عليه السلام), sent to the people of Thamud.

names.name: Hud
names.note: Prophet Hud (عليه السلام), sent to the people of 'Ad. A surah is named after him.

names.name: Shuaib
names.note: Prophet Shu'ayb (عليه السلام), sent to the people of Madyan.

names.name: Luqman
names.note: A wise man mentioned in the Quran, whose advice to his son forms Surah Luqman.

names.name: Ameen
names.note: A title of the Prophet (ﷺ) before prophethood. Means the Trustworthy One.

names.name: Anas
names.note: Anas ibn Malik (رضي الله عنه), personal servant of the Prophet (ﷺ) for 10 years.

names.name: Qasim
names.note: Name of the Prophet's (ﷺ) first son, from whom his kunya Abu Qasim comes.

names.name: Talha
names.note: Talha ibn Ubaydillah (رضي الله عنه), one of the ten promised paradise.

names.name: Zubayr
names.note: Al-Zubayr ibn al-Awwam (رضي الله عنه), one of the ten promised paradise.

names.name: Muaz
names.note: Muaz ibn Jabal (رضي الله عنه), highly knowledgeable Companion of the Prophet (ﷺ).

names.name: Walid
names.note: A classical Arabic name meaning one who is newly born or newly arrived.

names.name: Faisal
names.meaning: Decisive, separator of right from wrong
names.note: Carries the meaning of a judge or arbitrator who separates truth from falsehood.

names.name: Malik
names.note: Malik ibn Anas (رحمه الله), founder of the Maliki school of Islamic law.

names.name: Jamal
names.note: From the hadith: Allah is Beautiful and loves beauty.

names.name: Imran
names.note: The father of Maryam (Mary), mother of Isa (عليه السلام). Surah Al-Imran is named after his family.

names.name: Saad
names.note: Saad ibn Abi Waqqas (رضي الله عنه), one of the ten promised paradise.

names.name: Taha
names.note: Title of a surah (Surah 20). Often interpreted as a name or Quranic initials (huruf muqattaat).

names.name: Aziz
names.note: One of the 99 Names of Allah (Al-Aziz). Used as a personal name by Muslims.

names.name: Kareem
names.note: One of the 99 Names of Allah (Al-Kareem). Common personal name across the Muslim world.

names.name: Rashid
names.meaning: Rightly guided, on the right path
names.note: One of the 99 Names of Allah (Al-Rashid). Reflects guidance and righteousness.

names.name: Nasir
names.note: Reflects the concept of divine help and support in Islam.

names.name: Nabil
names.note: A name reflecting nobility of character and lineage.

names.name: Kamal
names.note: Represents the Islamic ideal of striving for excellence in character and deeds.

names.name: Ayman
names.note: Carries connotations of blessedness and good fortune.

names.name: Faris
names.note: Traditionally associated with chivalry, bravery, and nobility.

names.name: Ghalib
names.note: Reflects triumph and victory. Also the pen name of the great Urdu poet Mirza Ghalib.

names.name: Jafar
names.note: Jafar ibn Abi Talib (رضي الله عنه), cousin of the Prophet (ﷺ), martyred at Mu'ta.

names.name: Layth
names.note: A name symbolizing courage, strength, and bravery.

names.name: Mansur
names.note: Reflects divine aid and victory given by Allah to the believer.

names.name: Sabir
names.note: Sabr (patience) is among the highest virtues in Islam. Allah is with the patient.

names.name: Tawfiq
names.note: Refers to the success and guidance that comes from Allah alone.

names.name: Haidar
names.note: A title given to Ali ibn Abi Talib (رضي الله عنه) for his bravery.

names.name: Furqan
names.meaning: Criterion, separator of truth from falsehood
names.note: A name of the Quran mentioned in Surah Al-Furqan (25). Refers to discernment.

names.name: Rafiq
names.note: The Prophet (ﷺ) said: Allah is Rafiq (gentle) and loves gentleness in all things.

names.name: Numan
names.note: Al-Numan ibn Bashir (رضي الله عنه), Companion of the Prophet (ﷺ).

names.name: Rida
names.note: Represents the Islamic ideal of being content with Allah's decree (Ridha bil qadha).

names.name: Sufyan
names.note: Sufyan al-Thawri (رحمه الله), one of the greatest scholars of hadith.

names.name: Imad
names.note: Refers to being a pillar of strength and support.

names.name: Ghazi
names.meaning: Warrior, one who fights in the way of Allah
names.note: Historically given to warriors who fought for the defense of Islam.

names.name: Bakr
names.note: The name of a prominent Arab tribe. Abu Bakr's father's name was Abi Quhafa, but the kunya refers to Bakr.

names.name: Jabir
names.meaning: Comforter, one who sets bones, restorer
names.note: Jabir ibn Abdullah (رضي الله عنه), Companion who narrated many hadiths.

names.name: Kazim
names.meaning: One who controls anger, who swallows rage
names.note: The Quran (3:134) praises those who suppress their anger. A great virtue in Islam.

names.name: Rayan
names.note: One of the gates of Jannah mentioned in hadith, entered by those who fast.

names.name: Siraj
names.note: The Quran describes the Prophet (ﷺ) as Siraj Munir — a shining lamp (33:46).

names.name: Ziyad
names.note: A classical Arabic name representing blessing and increase in all goodness.

names.name: Talib
names.note: Seeking knowledge is an obligation in Islam. Abu Talib was the Prophet's (ﷺ) uncle.

names.name: Marwan
names.note: A classical name suggesting firmness and strength of character.

names.name: Kamil
names.note: Represents the Islamic aspiration for completeness in faith and character.

names.name: Badr
names.note: The Battle of Badr was the first major battle of Islam. The full moon symbolizes beauty and guidance.

names.name: Dawoud
names.note: Alternate transliteration of Dawud. Prophet David (عليه السلام).

names.name: Harith
names.note: A common pre-Islamic name retained in Islam. Associated with hard work and diligence.

names.name: Murtada
names.meaning: Approved, the one who is satisfied
names.note: A name of Ali ibn Abi Talib (رضي الله عنه) meaning the one with whom Allah is pleased.

names.name: Nawaf
names.note: Represents elevation in status, character, and rank.

names.name: Samir
names.meaning: Entertaining companion, one who converses at night
names.note: In Arabic tradition, Samir refers to a companion who entertains with stories.

names.name: Ubayda
names.note: Abu Ubayda ibn al-Jarrah (رضي الله عنه), one of the ten promised paradise, the trustee of the Ummah.

names.name: Waqas
names.note: Related to Saad ibn Abi Waqqas (رضي الله عنه), one of the ten promised paradise.

names.name: Yasin
names.note: Title of Surah 36, sometimes called the heart of the Quran. Often interpreted as a name for the Prophet (ﷺ).

names.name: Zafar
names.note: A name reflecting triumph and victory, popular across the Muslim world.

names.name: Ihsan
names.note: In hadith Jibril, Ihsan is defined as worshipping Allah as if you see Him.

names.name: Aqil
names.note: Reflects the importance of reason and wisdom in Islamic thought.

names.name: Bassam
names.note: Smiling is a sunnah of the Prophet (ﷺ), who said a smile is charity.

names.name: Dawlat
names.note: Common in South and Central Asian Muslim communities.

names.name: Fadl
names.note: Refers to the grace and bounty of Allah bestowed upon His servants.

names.name: Hisham
names.note: A name from a noble Arab tribe. Hisham ibn Abd al-Malik was an Umayyad caliph.

names.name: Iqbal
names.note: Muhammad Iqbal (رحمه الله), the great poet-philosopher of the Muslim world.

names.name: Jibril
names.meaning: Servant of Allah, mighty one of God
names.note: Angel Gabriel, the archangel who delivered revelation to the prophets.

names.name: Mikail
names.note: Angel Michael, responsible for natural phenomena and sustenance according to Islamic tradition.

names.name: Raed
names.note: Represents leadership and being first in exploring new paths.

names.name: Shafiq
names.note: Compassion is a central virtue in Islam — the Quran begins with Bismillah al-Rahman al-Rahim.

names.name: Wadud
names.note: One of the 99 Names of Allah (Al-Wadud). Refers to deep love and affection.
